name: Insights
description: Stroes the relation we generate based on the parent and his/her child details

schema.name: child_id
schema.description: References the children table for the child associated with the insight.

schema.name: journey_id
schema.description: References the Journey table for the journey associated with the insight.

schema.name: status
schema.description: Stores the status of the insights records

schema.name: teaser_text
schema.description: To store the teaser generated by Cloude AI Service

schema.name: request_id
schema.description: Identifier for the request that generated the insight.

schema.name: last_error
schema.description: Stores the last error message if insight processing fails.

schema.name: insights_api_payload
schema.description: Stores the JSON input used to generate the insight.
